verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine ships extensive first-party support for headless/CI automation: command-line arguments to run without full editor UI, UnrealEditor.exe -run=cook for headless cooking, the Unreal Automation Tool (UAT) explicitly described as a system 'used to automate processes, including testing and building games,' and Python editor scripting for automating asset/build pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of real CI pipelines using UE headlessly, and no mention of dedicated headless-rendering flags (e.g., nullrhi) or containerized CI setups in the evidence pack.
